Container.Name: library-cover-maker
Container.Overview: Makes animated cover art for your Jellyfin libraries. Add up to 5 videos or pictures, type the library name, and download an animated WebP that cuts between random moments from each, with a frame and the name in a big serif font. Everything runs in your browser, so your videos are never uploaded. No folders to map.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the Library Cover Maker web page. Jellyfin uses 8096, so the default is 8097.
